scope: Numbers 25–30, all 193 public verses. Prior revisions remain unchanged.

source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of the exact original XML verse substring, including written/read notes, not a normalized substitute.
source.public_versification_note: Public 25:1–18, 26:2–65, 27–28 and 29:1–39 align directly. Public 26:1 combines Hebrew 25:19 and 26:1, each bound separately in source_segments. Public 29:40 maps to Hebrew 30:1; public 30:1–16 maps to Hebrew 30:2–17. All 194 original records are hashed exactly for 193 public verses.

delta_method: F0 retained wording; F1 lexical; F2 syntax/idiom; F3 consequential interpretive, textual, social, or versification choice. Editorial assessments are separate from similarity scores. Independent review has not occurred.
